supportSite.installSentinelComment: Names a file this checkout really has after `npm ci`, for the local dev runner that decides whether to install. node_modules/.bin/ng never exists here, and probing for it would re-run npm ci on every start and wipe node_modules under a live server.

scripts.prebuild: node scripts/resolve-locales.mjs && node scripts/extract-theme-prelude.mjs && node scripts/check-copy-parity.mjs
scripts.check:publish: npm run build && rm -rf _site && mkdir -p _site && cp -r build/client/* _site/ && cp _site/404/index.html _site/404.html && touch _site/.nojekyll && node scripts/verify-publish-artifact.mjs "$PWD/_site"
